My name is Martin Heinz and I'm a software developer/DevOps engineer. I'm from Slovakia, living in Bratislava and currently working at IBM. You can find me on [![Twitter][1.2]][1], or on [![LinkedIn][3.2]][3]. ## ✍ Blog & Writing Apart from coding, I also maintain a blog - you can find my articles on my website at [martinheinz.dev](https://martinheinz.dev/) as well as on [Medium](https://medium.com/@martin.heinz) and [DEV.to](https://dev.to/martinheinz). ##
